note: compute_modified_premium (22 chars) — applies an NCCI experience modification factor to a caller-supplied subject premium (manual premium plus premium items subject to experience rating) to get the modified premium, whole dollars; consumes art-346 output_payload.mod read unchanged; mod <= 0 flags NONPOSITIVE_MOD and never yields a premium. Primary text pinned 2026-11-01: algorithm — ICRB Premium Algorithms page (icrb.net/references/premium-algorithms, dateModified 2026-06-11 snapshot): add to manual premium all premium items subject to experience rating to get total subject premium, then the experience modification is applied to arrive at the modified premium, per the NCCI Basic Manual-2021 Edition-Indiana algorithm and NCCI ABCs of Experience Rating PDF (ncci.com/articles/documents/uw_abc_exp_rating.pdf, fetched 2026-11-01: The mod is then applied to arrive at the modified premium); rounding — WCRB Wisconsin Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Basic Manual (wcrb.org/manuals/WI_Basic_Manual.pdf, fetched 2026-11-01, Premium Computation section C Whole Dollars - Premiums): All premiums shall be shown to the nearest dollar. A remainder of $0.50 or more shall be rounded to the next higher dollar. No NCCI or state rate table value is vendored; every licensed value is a caller input. pr bound once the PR opens.
